children: Whether you’re after a budget-friendly pick or the ultimate upgrade, find incredible deals on laptops and desktops for yourself and your loved ones

-- ASUS is kicking off the holiday season with major savings online at the ASUS Store as well as in store and online at Best Buy. From now until December 2, 2026, shoppers will find discounts on a vast selection of laptops and desktops to fit every kind of user.

image.alt: This Holiday Season, Save Up to 44% on a Wide Range of ASUS Tech!

children: Explore some of our top holiday picks below:
Value-conscious consumers who are seeking a practical everyday device.

Powered by the highly efficient Snapdragon® X processor, the ASUS Vivobook 14 delivers fast, responsive performance that’s backed by an impressive up to 29 hours of battery life. With 16GB of LPDDR5X memory and 512GB of storage, it offers the headroom for everyday multitasking, productivity, and entertainment without stretching your budget.
Everyday users who want reliable performance without compromising premium features.

Blending power-efficient Snapdragon® X performance with a vibrant OLED display, an ergonomic keyboard, and a full set of I/O ports in a thin and light all-metal chassis, the ASUS Zenbook 14 delivers an elevated, flagship-style experience for everyday productivity. Its nature-inspired Arctic Blue and Komodo Coral colorways, finished with the ASUS-exclusive Ceraluminum™ lid, add a personal touch of style.
Professionals who don’t want to compromise on performance, portability, or premium design.

Pairing AI-enhanced performance (Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 258V processor, 32GB of memory, and a 1TB SSD) with an ultraportable 0.47-inch, 2.65-pound design, the ASUS Zenbook S14 handles everything from daily computing to demanding workloads on the go. Its vibrant OLED display and immersive audio make it just as enjoyable for entertainment as it is for productivity. The ASUS-exclusive Ceraluminum™ lid in Scandinavian White adds a premium finish that exudes sophistication.
Creators who need workstation-class power in a compact, easy-to-carry form factor.

Combining NVIDIA’s RTX Spark Superchip with a 3K ASUS Lumina Pro Tandem OLED display, the ProArt P14 delivers workstation-class performance for creative work, gaming, and on-device AI without the traditional trade-off between power and mobility. Its precision CNC-crafted chassis houses a 90Wh battery for all-day productivity, while thoughtful features such as comprehensive I/O for dongle-free connectivity and a haptic touchpad deliver a refined user experience.
ROG Xbox Ally / ROG Xbox Ally X (RC73)
Starting at $599.99 for the ROG Xbox Ally and $999.99 for the ROG Xbox Ally X at ASUS Store or Best Buy
Gamers who want the flexibility to enjoy their favorite PC games at home or on the go.

Combining Xbox-inspired controls with the versatility of Windows PC gaming, the ROG Xbox Ally and Ally X deliver a comfortable, console-like handheld experience. Both feature AMD Ryzen™ Z2-series processors and 7-inch 120Hz displays, while the premium Ally X offers enhanced performance, additional memory, and a larger battery for more demanding gaming sessions.
Gamers and creators seeking capable gaming performance and everyday versatility in a compact, lightweight laptop.

Powered by the AMD Ryzen™ AI Max+ 392 processor with Radeon™ 8060S integrated graphics, the ASUS TUF Gaming A14 balances gaming and creative performance without a dedicated GPU. Its 14-inch 2.5K 165Hz display delivers smooth, detailed visuals, while its lightweight 3.26-pound design makes it easy to transition between gaming, productivity, and entertainment on the go.
Enthusiast gamers and content creators seeking premium gaming performance, stunning visuals, and portability.

Pairing an Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 386H processor with NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Ti Laptop graphics, the ROG Zephyrus G16 delivers powerful performance for demanding games and creative workloads. Its 16-inch 2.5K ROG Nebula HDR OLED display with a 240Hz refresh rate provides stunning visuals, while its sleek, approximately 4.3-pound aluminum chassis makes high-performance gaming more portable
Serious PC gamers seeking powerful, ready-to-play desktop performance without the hassle of building their own system.

Designed for high-performance gaming straight out of the box, the ROG GM700 combines AMD Ryzen™ processing with powerful dedicated graphics to handle demanding AAA titles and multitasking. Its spacious 58-liter chassis prioritizes airflow and cooling while providing room for future upgrades, making it a compelling prebuilt desktop for gamers who want both performance and flexibility.
All prices, discounts, and promotional timelines are subject to change at any time without notice. Promotional products are subject to availability.
